_source: Story steps written by hand from the Serebii (Yellow) and The Cave of Dragonflies (FRLG) walkthroughs; see scripts/build-story.py.

steps.name: Leave your house

es.name: Sal de tu casa
es.detail: Empiezas en tu cuarto, arriba: baja las escaleras y sal por la puerta.

steps.detail: You start in your room upstairs: go down the stairs and out the door.

steps.name: Head for the tall grass

es.name: Ve hacia la hierba alta
es.detail: El Prof. Oak te detiene y te lleva a su laboratorio a elegir tu primer Pokémon.

steps.detail: Professor Oak stops you and takes you to his lab to choose your first Pokémon.

steps.name: Deliver Oak's Parcel

es.name: Entrega el Paquete de Oak
es.detail: Lleva el paquete de la tienda de Verde al Prof. Oak: te da la Pokédex y cinco Poké Balls.

steps.detail: Bring the parcel from the Viridian Mart back to Oak: he gives you the Pokédex and five Poké Balls.

steps.name: Watch the old man catch a Pokémon

es.name: Mira al anciano atrapar un Pokémon
es.detail: Con la Pokédex ya se ha tomado su café: te enseña a atrapar y te deja pasar.

steps.detail: Once you have the Pokédex he has had his coffee: he shows you how to catch and lets you through.

steps.name: Open the hideout behind the Game Corner poster

es.name: Abre la guarida tras el póster del Casino
es.detail: Vence al Rocket delante del póster y pulsa el interruptor que hay detrás.

steps.detail: Beat the Rocket in front of the poster and press the switch behind it.

steps.name: Calm the ghost of Marowak

es.name: Calma al fantasma de Marowak
es.detail: Con el Visor Silph puedes verlo y combatirlo; después se abre el paso hacia arriba.

steps.detail: With the Silph Scope you can see it and battle it; then the way up opens.

steps.name: Rescue Mr. Fuji

es.name: Rescata al Sr. Fuji
es.detail: En lo alto de la torre, tras tres Rockets. En su casa te da la Poké Flauta.

steps.detail: At the top of the tower, after three Rockets. He thanks you with the Poké Flute at his house.

steps.name: Sail with Bill to One Island

es.name: Viaja con Bill a Isla Prima
es.detail: Tras vencer a Blaine, Bill te espera en este Centro Pokémon: dile que sí y el barco os lleva a las Islas Sete.

steps.detail: After beating Blaine, Bill waits in this Pokémon Center: say yes and the ferry takes you both to the Sevii Islands.

steps.name: Get the National Pokédex

es.name: Recibe la Pokédex Nacional
es.detail: Tras ser Campeón, con 60 Pokémon vistos, el Prof. Oak mejora tu Pokédex.

steps.detail: After becoming Champion, with 60 Pokémon seen, Professor Oak upgrades your Pokédex.

steps.name: Give the Sapphire to Celio

es.name: Entrega el Zafiro a Celio
es.detail: Trae el Zafiro del Almacén Rocket: Celio termina su red.

steps.detail: Bring back the Sapphire from the Rocket Warehouse: Celio finishes his network.
